messages:
maya (Billing Ops): Heads up — we got reports from two customers that March invoices contained negative tax line items and one customer got two invoices with the same invoice_id. attaching sample snippet below. :warning:

maya (Billing Ops): Sample (redacted):
```json
{
  "invoice_id": "2025-03-INV-0423",
  "customer": "acme-inc",
  "lines": [
    {"desc": "API tokens", "amount": 1200},
    {"desc": "reserved capacity credit", "amount": -200},
    {"desc": "tax", "amount": -50}
  ],
  "total": 950
}
```

sanjay (FinOps): Yikes. Is this from the merge of reserved credits? last deploy touched the billing template. cc @deploy-bot :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: billing-generator v2.9.1 -> prod by ci/CD at 1765430000. No immediate rollback triggered.

invoices-bot: ERROR: duplicate invoice_id detected for customer acme-inc: 2025-03-INV-0423 (job invoice_batch_2025_03_31).

olivia (Payments): Negative tax lines will break payment gateway validation — we'll see rejections. Have we blocked refunds previously?

elaine (Acct Mgmt): I already had an upset user — said they were charged twice but one PDF showed negative tax line. Can we quickly flag affected customers for outreach? :telephone_receiver:

james (Revenue): The reserved capacity credit merge logic was updated in the generator last week to apply prorated credits. Maybe sign flip when combined with tax calc? quick hypothesis: credits are being treated as taxable credits rather than pre-tax adjustments.

maya (Billing Ops): Running a dry-run reconcile for affected batch now: `./scripts/generate_invoices --batch 2025-03-31 --reconcile --dry-run --customer acme-inc`

sanjay (FinOps): Can you also run this query to surface duplicates?
```
SELECT invoice_id, count(*) FROM invoices WHERE period = '2025-03' GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING count(*) > 1;
```

maya (Billing Ops): Ran it — returns 1 row: `2025-03-INV-0423, 2`. Also found 6 invoices with negative tax amounts across three customers.

olivia (Payments): Please pause auto-capture for affected customers until we fix — I'll mark the gateway hold.

james (Revenue): If it's template logic, we need hotfix. @sanjay can you triage with eng? I can provide a rollback window for reserved credits change.

sanjay (FinOps): Pinged eng-billing infra. @deploy-bot can we rollback billing-generator to v2.9.0?

deploy-bot: Rollback request received. Preflight check: 2 running jobs depend on v2.9.1 (invoice_batch_2025_03_31, reconciliation_job). Proceed? (yes/no)

maya (Billing Ops): Hold on — don't rollback until we have a mitigation. If we rollback mid-run we might leave partial duplicates. Suggest: 1) pause new invoice emissions 2) mark affected IDs as "investigating" in db 3) run cleanup script to merge/remove duplicate rows 4) issue corrected reissue invoices.

elaine (Acct Mgmt): I'll draft outreach message and hold refunds until we confirm corrected invoices.

sanjay (FinOps): Agreed. Eng asked for the generator logs — attaching error slice: `ERROR compute_tax(): negative_tax_amount for invoice_id 2025-03-INV-0423 — credit_applied=200, tax_base=150 -> tax = -50`

maya (Billing Ops): Creating a ticket with attachments and escalation to priority 1. Will follow up with final customer list shortly. :white_check_mark:
